# Customs — both sides of the agentic counter

> Machine index for coding agents, judges and any reader who arrives with a
> token budget. Everything is verifiable by command; nothing is asserted.

## what

A two-sided agentic checkout for the Razorpay AI Buildathon 2026 (Track 1 —
AI Growth & Agentic Commerce). Buyer side: a chat storefront where an agent
searches, builds a cart, requests an Ed25519-signed spending mandate and pays
inside its bounds. Merchant side: a control room with the channel P&L meter
(agent GMV minus AI serving cost, live, at-1M projection), human approvals
over ₹10,000, order ledger, span replay, protocol ablation and a red-team log.
Test mode only; without Razorpay keys the rail is a labeled simulation.

## how to verify

- `make triage` — 60-second self-guided tour (prints claims, runs checks, exits 0)
- `make verify` — the exact checks CI runs on every push (zero deps)
- `make test` — fuzz + ablation + audit + ledger-fork (concurrent-writer convergence), exit codes propagate
- `make demo` — run the product (no keys needed)
- `make kit` — an external agent walks the golden path over pure HTTP (the agent-kit proof)

## key files

- JUDGE.md — claims mapped to the judging criteria + evidence commands
- PAPER.md — the working paper: problem, protocol, economics, evaluation (twin of the in-app paper view)
- README.md — product overview, quickstart, file map
- ARCHITECTURE.md — the one diagram, decisions table, threat model
- AGENTS.md — working guide + the 11 invariants
- docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md — the design contract: tokens, type, motion rules, the mascot containment law (read before touching any UI)
- ENGINEERING_LOG.md — dated incidents; every incident became a test
- CLEANUP.md — what to delete before pushing to GitHub
- DEPLOY.md — the operating runbook: run locally, keep alive, deploy free, operate
- AGENT_KIT.md — bring your own agent: the counter's HTTP contract; /api/mcp is a REAL MCP server (Streamable HTTP, 2025-06-18), /api/acp a core REST profile with Ed25519-signed receipts; `make kit` proves an outside client clears the counter
- src/lib/customs/gate/ — mandate contract, canonical JSON, decision checklist
- src/lib/customs/ledger/ — hash-chained JSONL audit trail (the database)
- src/lib/customs/fuzz/corpus.ts — the 12 authored attacks, expected verdicts
- src/lib/customs/meter.ts — channel P&L + projection, assumptions declared
- src/components/customs/why.tsx — the why page: architecture drawn as cards + desk ledger (shipped / simulated / the work order for next)
- src/components/customs/agent-kit.tsx — the agent kit view: the HTTP contract, the protocol, and a live golden-path walkthrough in-page
- src/components/customs/paper.tsx — the paper view: a clean theme-aware document page; §5–§6 numbers read live from the ledger
- src/components/customs/demo-player.tsx — the landing demo: the golden path plays itself in code, loops (docs/demo.gif is a recording of it)
- src/components/customs/hero-bot.tsx — the customs bot: one smooth animated volume on the hero, token-inked, reduced-motion aware
- src/components/customs/theme.tsx — dark/light theme toggle (footer, persisted, no flash)
- docs/demo.gif — the recorded golden path (embedded in README.md)
- results/ — every measured number, JSON only, regeneration-only

## numbers policy

No number is hand-written. Measured values enter via `make meter|fuzz|ablation|project|audit`.
Latency is machine-dependent and never cited as a promise. Competitor numbers never appear.

## status

Live deployment: https://customs.srivtx.xyz — /api/health answers ok:true on
real Razorpay test rails (simulated:false). Payment rail: test mode when keys
are set; labeled in-process simulation as the no-keys fallback. x402: declared
stretch goal, not core scope.
